title: PlurVA-LLM-2026 Shared Task Track-1: Pluralistic Value Alignment in LLMs via Multilingual Fine-Tuning and Threshold Calibration

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and fine-tuning models on community-specific value dilemma datasets (Chinese, Indonesian, and Sri Lankan) to test alignment with locally grounded societal values rather than a single universal preference.

Addressing and evaluating performance disparities across varying resource levels by comparing a high-resource language (Chinese) with lower-resource languages (Indonesian and Sinhala) using a shared multilingual fine-tuning approach.
Applying cyclic option-permutation augmentation and averaging probabilities across permutations to reduce the model's sensitivity to the display order of multiple-choice options.
